item.title: Review links cannabis use to higher rates of violence
item.description: A review of more than 265,000 people found that cannabis use was associated with higher rates of both committing violence and becoming a victim of it.

item.title: Mulberry may alter gut bacteria and affect metabolism
item.description: Mulberry compounds may reshape the gut microbiome in ways that support intestinal health and metabolism, with some combinations showing particularly strong effects.
